label: Enterprise Edition (Couchbase Lite)
type: Couchbase Lite's own independent Enterprise/Community edition split, gating a disjoint feature set (Predictive Query, Delta Sync, Database Encryption) from server/'s (GSI, eventing, etc.)
note: Deliberately not the same concept as edition:enterprise (server/) - same word, same general shape (a two-tier license split), but a different feature set entirely.
